tools.name: unwrap_and_clean_china_marketplace_link
tools.description: Extract clean canonical product IDs and native raw URLs from wrapped Taobao, 1688, Weidian, or third-party shopping agent redirect links (Superbuy, CNFans, Mulebuy, AllChinaBuy), stripping tracking tokens.

tools.name: calculate_volumetric_haul_shipping
tools.description: Calculate chargeable shipping weight comparing actual scale weight vs dimensional volumetric weight (L x W x H / 5000 for DHL/FedEx, /6000 for Tax-Free Line, /8000 for EUB) and recommend box removal savings.

tools.name: compare_china_shopping_agents
tools.description: Compare verified Chinese purchasing agents (Basetao, CSSBuy, Kakobuy, Sugargoo, Superbuy, Mulebuy, AllChinaBuy, CNFans) by hidden USD/CNY exchange rate markup (4.8% to 6.8%), parcel weight freight, and total landed cost.

tools.name: convert_asian_apparel_and_shoe_size
tools.description: Convert Chinese/Asian apparel labels (M, L, XL, 2XL, 175/92A) and Chinese EU shoe sizes to US/UK standards with exact centimeter chest/shoulder ranges, flagging Asian slim-fit sizing allowances.

tools.name: estimate_customs_declaration_strategy
tools.description: Compute standard weight-based customs declaration benchmarks ($12-$14/kg reference for North America vs Tax-Free Triangle IOSS lines for EU/UK) and ideal parcel split thresholds (<10kg).

tools.name: list_verified_china_sourcing_tools
tools.description: Retrieve direct landing endpoints for TaoFind 1688 link cleaner, Weidian unwrapper, shipping calculator, Asian size converter, and agent fee matrix.
